tables.name: Beneath the Surface
tables.description: Extra Intrigue. Something happening that not everyone is aware of.

results.name: Pack
results.description: A pack of particularly feral animals roams the city.

results.name: Monster
results.description: A monster lurks somewhere in the city.

results.name: Markings
results.description: Strange markings have been showing up around the city.

results.name: Fight Club
results.description: A fight club has started somewhere in the city, and may be gaining more participants.

results.name: Secret
results.description: Some portion of the populace is not as they seem.

results.name: Outside Contact
results.description: Someone in the city is in regular communication with an interesting external contact.

results.name: Tampering
results.description: Someone is interfering with forces best left alone.

results.name: Unsafe
results.description: There is a structural problem with a location within the city (or, possibly, the land, or environment, it is built on). The longer it goes unnoticed, the more damaging it could be.

results.name: Parties
results.description: A guerilla party scene has been emerging within the city, with semi-frequent, secret, invitation-only parties being held at ever-changing locations.

results.name: Black Market
results.description: An underground black-market has been established, dealing in the movement of illicit goods or services.

results.name: Races
results.description: A racing circuit has been established outside the city.

results.name: Haunted
results.description: The city is being haunted by some kind of spirit.
